name: Chicago food-facility commercial pest control (SW-side route) with residential/landlord plan line
summary: One IDPH-licensed pest company: founder becomes the Certified Technician, wins food establishments in Chicago's SW cluster (60608/60609/60616/60623/60632) using CDPH inspection triggers (pest citations, repeat offenders, new licences), adds residential/2-6-flat landlord quarterly plans as a secondary line. Customer unit = blended service account (~75% commercial monthly, ~25% residential quarterly). Technician labour is capacity-triggered staff (founder services the first ~110 accounts); gross margin covers materials/devices only. Stage E refresh (2026-11-28): licensing timeline re-dated to the posted IDPH exam calendar, win rate cut for the 7-day re-inspection finding, overhead/capex start aligned with licensure, standardized draw/tax/injection and evidenced long-term drivers. The fire-extinguisher (OSFM) second licence is NOT in this model (see WS05-001 model).
evidence_notes: Demand (Stage E re-query, 2025-11-26..2026-11-25): 10,140 Chicago food licences inspected; 2,008 cited under violation 38; 942 with pest-activity evidence in inspector comments (stricter regex than Stage D's 1,416, which counted gap-only 'rodent' comments); SW cluster 165 of 1,492 (11.1%) [A, E-WS05007-S001].

Urgency correction: after a failed inspection with pest activity the next inspection follows a median 7 days later (59% within 7 days, 93% within 14) and 80% pass it; only 8.5% still show pests [A, E-WS05007-S001]. The incumbent usually resolves the crisis before a newcomer arrives, so the 'rescue before re-inspection' pitch works mainly for repeat offenders.

Rule floor: CDPH inspectors cite that retail food establishments must contract with a licensed Illinois exterminator providing service at least twice a year and keep a 12-month logbook with service reports and the company's IDPH licence number (Municipal Code 7-38-020(C)) [A, E-WS05007-S001; code text itself not retrievable].

Pricing: restaurants ~$100-150/mo [D, C2-S020]; operator-published restaurant range $50-422/mo [D, C2-S019]; public per-building bids $30-180/mo [A, C2-S017]; Chicago residential monthly visit ~$40-70 [D, DA-S021]. No Chicago commercial rate card found (MISSING).

Churn: Rentokil North America customer retention 80.7%/yr [B, C2-S009] -> ~1.8%/mo; commercial retention target >94% and independents ~85-88% per trade press [D, E-WS05007-S009]; ~9.7% of inspected Chicago food licences recorded 'Out of Business' in 12 months [A, E-WS05007-S001].

Labour: Chicago MSA pest control workers median $46,740 [C, C2-S021] (Correction: Stage D cited DA-S011, which is the janitor wage table). Insurance: broker averages GL $112/mo, auto $114/mo [C, DA-S010]; statutory minimum limits [A, C2-S004].

Supply: Veseris branch 3642 S Kedzie Ave requires applicator licence number [B, DA-S014]; Pest Management Supply, Inc. holds a Chicago wholesale licence at 2027-2029 S Wabash Ave (60616) [A, E-WS05007-S005]. Software: GorillaDesk $49-149/mo first route [B, DA-S016].

Win rates, lead volumes, CAC and one-time revenue remain analyst assumptions (E) to be tested by the validation plan. Incumbent gross margin (Rollins 52.8% incl. labour) is incumbent economics, not used directly.

drivers.sales_start_delay_months__source: IDPH exam calendar (fetched 2026-11-28) lists Westchester sessions 12/16/2026 (10 seats each) and no 2027 dates yet; application must be RECEIVED 15 days before the exam (i.e., by 1 Dec for 16 Dec) [A, E-WS05007-S002, WS05-S013]. Base assumes a January 2027 sitting, then business licence ($250) + insurance certificate; processing time MISSING. Optimistic = December seat obtained; conservative = February sitting or a re-take.
drivers.sales_cycle_months__source: Restaurants decide in days after a citation; plants 1-3 months (Stage A/C, E).
drivers.founder_leads_per_month__source: Composition (Stage E, SW cluster, 12 months [A, E-WS05007-S001/S004]): ~14/mo licences with pest activity, ~22/mo other violation-38 citations (gaps, door sweeps, logbooks), ~10/mo newly issued Retail Food licences = ~46 trigger sites/mo; assume ~60% reach a decision-maker (~28) + ~10 residential inbound + ~7 cold/referral walk-ins = 45. Conversation volume is E.
drivers.lead_to_proposal_pct__source: Analyst estimate; free inspection offered on the spot.
drivers.proposal_to_win_pct__source: Correction (Stage E): cut from 0.22/0.30/0.38. Displacement sale (most cited sites already have a provider [A, C2-S014]); re-inspection follows a failed pest inspection in a median 7 days and 80% pass [A, E-WS05007-S001], so the newcomer usually arrives after the incumbent has fixed the crisis. L.E.K.: ~37% of facility managers switched some provider in the past year [C, DA-S019]. Still E.
drivers.rep_new_customers_per_month__source: Analyst estimate for a commissioned route-sales rep.
drivers.referral_new_per_100_active__source: Analyst estimate (owner networks, landlords with multiple buildings).
drivers.monthly_churn_pct__source: Rentokil NA retention 80.7%/yr [B, C2-S009] = 1.77%/mo; conservative adds new-entrant quality risk and restaurant closures [A, DA-S001].
drivers.arpc_monthly__source: Blend 75% commercial at ~$125/mo (restaurants $100-150 [D, C2-S020]; wholesale food plants higher, E) + 25% residential at ~$45/mo equivalent (Chicago monthly visit $40-70 [D, DA-S021]; quarterly plans ~$120-150/qtr, E).
drivers.onetime_revenue_per_new_customer__source: Initial cleanout + exclusion (1,267 of 3,182 CDPH pest comments cite door gaps/openings [A, DA-S001]); Rollins: ~25% of revenue non-recurring [A, C2-S008]. Ticket size E.
drivers.arpc_annual_growth_pct__source: Annual price increase assumption; L.E.K.: >95% of FMs have escalators in some multi-year contracts [C, DA-S019].
drivers.gross_margin_pct__source: Materials/devices/logbook consumables only (~9-12% of revenue, Stage C E); technician labour and vehicles are in Staff.
drivers.onetime_gross_margin_pct__source: Rodent stations, door sweeps, sealants installed at cost ~$80-110 per new account (E).
drivers.variable_opex_pct_revenue__source: Fuel/route variable + card fees + bad debt; Rollins fleet ~5.2% of revenue incl. ownership [A, C2-S008]; set 6% (fuel ~3%, processing 2%, bad debt 1%).
drivers.cac_per_new_customer__source: Commercial canvassing near-zero cash; residential paid leads (Google LSA) assumed $60-120/lead at ~40% close; blended E.
drivers.fixed_marketing_per_month__source: Website, Google Business, LSA floor budget, print (E).
drivers.dso_days__source: Rollins DSO ~20 days (incumbent) [A, C2-S008]; residential autopay; restaurants net-15.
drivers.dpo_days__source: Veseris offers an online credit application [B, DA-S014]; actual terms MISSING; conservative = card/COD.
drivers.start_capital_injection__source: Standardized: smallest amount (rounded up to $100) that keeps the BASE-case cash balance >= 0 with the $4k/mo draw from month 13 = $47,300. Same injection in all scenarios; conservative/optimistic cash balances show the resulting gap/surplus.
drivers.ev_multiple__source: BizBuySell sold service businesses 2021-25: owner-earnings multiple lower quartile 1.75, median 2.38, upper quartile 3.13 [D, E-WS05007-S007]; Rentokil paid ~$37m for businesses with ~$26m prior-year revenue in H1 2026 (~1.4x revenue, incl. contingent) [B, E-WS05007-S006]. Base 3.0x SDE-basis for a recurring contract book; operating profit here is before owner pay (SDE-like).
drivers.lt_growth_y6_pct__source: Rollins 2025 organic growth: commercial 7.6%, residential 5.0% [A, C2-S008] (incumbent); contract escalators ~3% common [C, DA-S019]. Base 8% = route additions slowing; conservative 3% = price escalators only; optimistic 12% = second route cluster.
drivers.lt_growth_decay__source: Analyst: density gains fade as the five-ZIP cluster saturates; second cluster needs a second CT/location [A, C2-S003].
drivers.incremental_roic_pct__source: Derived from model drivers: once the founder stops selling, a rep at ~$5.5k/mo adding ~4 accounts/mo implies ~$1,500 acquisition cost per account vs ~$56/mo contribution after technician time and ~56-month life (1.8%/mo churn) -> ~2x lifetime return, ~40-60%/yr pre-tax; conservative 30% if churn or rep productivity disappoint.
drivers.maint_capex_pct_op__source: Vehicles are leased (in overhead/staff cost); maintenance capex = sprayers, insect-light traps, stations, tablets replaced on 3-5 yr cycles (E).
drivers.reserve_months__source: Policy: 2 months of cash operating costs (3 in conservative) because insurance renewals and winter seasonality (Dec inspection pest share 4.8% vs Sep 8.8% [A, E-WS05007-S001]) bunch cash needs.
drivers.founder_draw_per_month__source: Standardized for cross-finalist comparability (STAGE_E_PROTOCOL.md): $4,000/mo draw from month 13; 30% blended tax.
drivers.founder_draw_start_month__source: Standardized for cross-finalist comparability (STAGE_E_PROTOCOL.md): $4,000/mo draw from month 13; 30% blended tax.
drivers.tax_rate_pct__source: Standardized for cross-finalist comparability (STAGE_E_PROTOCOL.md): $4,000/mo draw from month 13; 30% blended tax.

staff.notes: Chicago MSA median $46,740/yr [C, C2-S021] (Correction: Stage D cited DA-S011, the janitor table) x ~1.25 load (payroll tax, WC, Chicago paid leave) = ~$4,870 + leased van/fuel ~$850. Capacity ~190 blended accounts (8-12 commercial stops/day; residential quarterly). Supervision rule allows uncertified techs [A, C2-S002]. Threshold uses base value (structural).
Scheduling, logbooks/audit reports, billing. Chicago wage $17.05 floor [A, DA-S013]; ~$45-50k loaded (E).

staff.role: Commercial sales rep (salary + commission), hired once the book reaches 300 accounts
staff.notes: E. Test: a salaried rep hired at month 20 regardless of scale cut base yr-3 operating profit to ~$4k, because at ~$105 ARPC a rep adding 4 accounts/mo needs >12 months to cover cost. Hire on scale, keep pay commission-heavy.
Second CT needed for a second licensed location [A, C2-S003]; E cost.
